Title: Document 3
Content: Source: Huan Tan, upper-class Han philosopher, New Discourses, about `text(20 C.E.)`

Fuxi* invented the pestle and the mortar. Later on, the pestle and the mortar were cleverly improved in such a way that the whole weight of the body could be used, thus increasing the efficiency `text(ten)` times. In time, the power of animals — donkeys, mules, oxen and horses — was added. Later, water power was also applied, and the benefit was increased a `text(hundredfold)`.
